name: Dang Hun Mountain
pedia: A mountain that shakes the soul harder the higher one climbs; broken souls become Guts Gu. Units beside it are tempered: +15% battle XP.
pedia_id: Gunung yang mengguncang jiwa makin keras makin tinggi didaki; jiwa yang hancur menjadi Gu Nyali. Unit di sampingnya tertempa: +15% XP pertempuran.

name: Luo Po Valley
pedia: A valley of soul-loosening fog and soul-cutting wind, one of the soul path's two holy lands. Units that end their turn inside take 15 damage; those that come out fight 10% harder.
pedia_id: Lembah kabut pelepas jiwa dan angin pemotong jiwa, salah satu dari dua tanah suci jalur jiwa. Unit yang mengakhiri giliran di dalamnya menerima 15 kerusakan; yang keluar bertarung 10% lebih kuat.

name: Reverse Flow River
pedia: A river where no Gu works and attacks rebound. Units beside it bear its seal: +15% defending.
pedia_id: Sungai tempat Gu tak berfungsi dan serangan berbalik. Unit di sampingnya membawa segelnya: +15% saat bertahan.

name: River of Time
comment: touched by the currents of time
pedia: Time-path currents where Red Lotus's stone lotus islands drift. Units beside it fight 10% harder.
pedia_id: Arus jalur waktu tempat pulau-pulau teratai batu Teratai Merah hanyut. Unit di sampingnya bertarung 10% lebih kuat.

name: Door of Life and Death
pedia: The door that draws the dead in; since Fate Gu's wound some escape as zombies. Units beside it heal 10 HP more.
pedia_id: Pintu yang menarik masuk orang mati; sejak Gu Takdir terluka sebagian lolos sebagai mayat hidup. Unit di sampingnya pulih 10 HP lebih banyak.

name: Book Mountain
pedia: A mountain of books with an ink waterfall and a literature spring. +5 science; units beside it gain 20% more XP.
pedia_id: Gunung buku dengan air terjun tinta dan mata air sastra. +5 sains; unit di sampingnya mendapat 20% XP lebih banyak.

name: Crazed Demon Cave
pedia: A cave whose demonic sound drives creatures mad; Limitless's inheritance lies within. Units that end their turn inside take 20 damage; survivors attack 15% harder.
pedia_id: Gua yang suara iblisnya membuat makhluk gila; warisan Tanpa Batas ada di dalamnya. Unit yang mengakhiri giliran di dalamnya menerima 20 kerusakan; yang selamat menyerang 15% lebih kuat.

name: Dragon Whale Paradise
comment: blessed by the azure dragon whale
pedia: Paradise Earth's Eastern Sea inheritance inside the azure dragon whale. Units beside it heal 10 HP more.
pedia_id: Warisan Laut Timur Bumi Surga di dalam paus naga biru. Unit di sampingnya pulih 10 HP lebih banyak.

name: Tian Ti Mountain
pedia: The ruined stair to the Heavenly Court; fighting on it affronts the Court. Units beside it see 1 tile farther.
pedia_id: Tangga runtuh menuju Istana Langit; bertarung di atasnya menghina Istana. Unit di sampingnya melihat 1 petak lebih jauh.

name: Lang Ya Blessed Land
pedia: The hairy men's blessed land, where refinement succeeds more often and the land spirit trades Gu. Units beside it fight 10% harder.
pedia_id: Tanah berkah manusia berbulu, tempat penyulingan lebih sering berhasil dan roh tanah memperdagangkan Gu. Unit di sampingnya bertarung 10% lebih kuat.

name: Imperial Court Blessed Land
pedia: Opens every ten years to the contest's winner and shelters from the killing blizzard. Units beside it defend 15% harder.
pedia_id: Terbuka setiap sepuluh tahun bagi pemenang kontes dan melindungi dari badai salju maut. Unit di sampingnya bertahan 15% lebih kuat.

name: Hu Immortal Blessed Land
pedia: A rank-six aperture on Tian Ti Mountain, won by the first to climb Dang Hun Mountain. +3 happiness; units beside it move 1 tile farther.
pedia_id: Apertur tingkat enam di Gunung Tian Ti, dimenangkan oleh yang pertama mendaki Gunung Dang Hun. +3 kebahagiaan; unit di sampingnya bergerak 1 petak lebih jauh.
